title: One impression in 1,398 is clicked; one bid in 4.4 wins
number: 53,289,330 bids → 12,237,081 impressions (win rate 23.0%) → 8,751 clicked (CTR 0.072%, 95% CI 0.070%–0.073%) → 391 post-click conversions; CPM 78.3, CPC 110
confidence: High (exact counts, reconciled with the dataset paper)
meaning: Expected value of 1,000 impressions = 1,000 × P(click) × P(conversion | click) × value per conversion = 0.72 clicks × 4.5% × value. To hit a target CPA T, CPM must stay below 0.032 × T. This is the yardstick for every bid.
